about_the_game:
The apocalypse is here...and it's beat for the gods!

How likely was it that your debut as a drag artist would be overshadowed by a zombie apocalypse? No one expected it, but overnight the world is full of paint-splattered zombies invading the streets in search of new victims to make up and convert. For some reason, drags with their excess of infected make-up have acquired superpowers and are now humanity's only salvation.

The demo... is serving!

This demo covers the first few minutes of the game, which take place in the prologue and inside the Disco Zoo, where the zombie apocalypse begins. You'll be able to experience our fresh narrative first-hand, learn what a catfight is, and even compose your own song in a lipsync! Meet some of the main characters. This Killer Eyelashes demo is designed to whet your appetite for the final game:

  • Complete missions for non-player characters.

  • Talk to and discover things about the characters at the disco.

Things you won't find in the demo

  • Multiple endings. The demo is self-contained.

  • Custom avatar. In the final game, you'll be able to create your own drag character and change their appearance. You'll also receive new outfits and accessories that you can use.

  • Superpowers. These are developed later in the story.

  • Catfight to death. Some catfights are against powerful rivals and it won't be easy to escape them.

Investigate

In a word full of zombies and, of course, drag queens, you can trust no one. You better investigate and get all the clues and secrets from the characters. You will unlock their traits and make it easier to progress through the story... or you can just go ahead and face whatever comes your way!

Catfight your enemies

There is no health bar in Killer Eyelashes... there is a dignity bar! If you lose all your dignity, you are worse than dead. You will defeat your enemies in catfights: a type of narrative combat in which you’ll have to overcome your enemy’s shades with the best response. To win the catfight, you must deplete your opponent’s dignity bar.

Lipsyncs

Put on an amazing show. You know the words… right? Compose your song and try to match what the audience wants to hear to get the best score. Whether you make it perfect or a complete disaster. It will definitely be fun!

Big purse

You’ll find all sorts of items and gadgets during your adventure – save them! You might need them at some point.

content_descriptors.notes: Killer Eyelashes contains stylized violence, strong language, suggestive content, and references to alcohol use. The game also explores themes related to gender identity and self-expression. Some dialogue and situations may be considered sensitive or mature. All content is presented in a fictional and stylized context intended for adult audiences.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Big Sur 11 or newer
  • Processor: Intel or Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs

name: Killer Eyelashes (Demo)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer (X64), Windows 11 21H2 (build 22000) or newer (Arm64)
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: The apocalypse has arrived, and it comes in the form of a door! Uncover its secrets, solve puzzles by finding objects, and outsmart your rivals! Your mission in this post-apocalyptic adventure is to discover the truth without losing your dignity.
